name: 塔防编辑器TowerDefenseEditor
detailed_description:
• This is a tower defense game editor that allows you to create your own games. In it, you can experience various strange and different types of tower defense games, and also create your own tower defense games.

  • The game has built-in chess pieces, plot models, special effects, and sound effects resources.

  • If you are not satisfied with the built-in resources of the editor, you can also use the Unity engine of the same version of this game to upload resources to the Creative Workshop. After subscribing, you can use them in the game, allowing your favorite characters to fight enemies in the way you like.

  • In the resource preview scenario, built-in or creative workshop downloaded resources can be previewed, and the selected resources can be generated into corresponding table configurations with one click

  • When making a map, you can freely place plots, design NPC walking routes, decorate the map, and place initial chess pieces.

  • All module production can be achieved by modifying tables, with built-in animation state machines、buff、Timer, trigger, skill, bullet, map plot, sound effects playback, special effects playback and other systems.

  • Having a high degree of freedom, the production of chess pieces' combat logic depends on your imagination, and chess pieces and maps can add many interesting interactions

  • If you also enjoy making tower defense games but struggle with not knowing how to code and art, then you can learn about this game. Just click and enter some values, and use the behaviors provided in the editor to create a tower defense game.

  • If you have some code foundation and the game also has built-in Lua script writing function, you can achieve more complex logic by writing Lua scripts

  • After the game is completed, it can be uploaded to the creative workshop for other players to download and play

  • Of course, if you only want to play and not make a game, you can search for games made by other players that you like in the creative workshop. After subscribing, you can play in this game

  • At present, the editor has a built-in level for defending radishes and a level for plant vs. zombie as references

  • The editor is currently not fully developed and will continue to update its features to enable it to create more types of tower defense games
